newsitem.title: DENMARK: Nykredit rejects closer BG Bank ties-paper.
newsitem.headline: Nykredit rejects closer BG Bank ties-paper.

text.p: Board members of Danish mortgage lender Nykredit have rejected plans by chief executive Mogens Munk Rasmussen to strengthen an exisiting sales alliance with BG Bank, the Danish daily Jyllands-Posten said on Friday.

There has long been market talk that the country's biggest mortgage-lender and third largest bank could merge, possibly joined by insurer Topdanmark, but the paper said that directors refused at a board meeting late on Thursday night.
Neither Nykredit nor BG Bank executives could immediately be reached for comment on Friday but a Nykredit announcement was expected later in the morning.
Jyllands-Posten said that it was not clear if the rejection would affect the current strategic alliance between Nykredit, BG Bank and Topdanmark.
Nykredit has a 15 percent stake in BG Bank and 14 percent of Topdanmark, while BG Bank holds 10 percent of Topdanmark, which has a five percent stake in the bank.
BG Bank's share rose on Thursday afternoon on speculation of a full merger but fell back toward the end of trade, closing at 325 crowns, three up on Wednesday's close.
